**Observations:**
1. **Output biases (`b3`, 12 × 12 grid) form a triangular silhouette:**
   When reshaped into a 12 × 12 grid (row $r = 0..11$, column $c = 0..11$, index $12r + c$), `b3` is strongly negative around the entire outer border and upper corners, while values near $0$ or positive form an upright triangle in the center:
   - **Row 0 (pixels 0..11):** all values lie between `-0.518` and `-0.333`.
   - **Left & right borders (col 0 and col 11, all rows):** all values lie between `-0.535` and `-0.340`.
   - **Row 1 (pixels 12..23):** strongly negative at cols 0..3 (`-0.340, -0.470, -0.492, -0.359`) and cols 8..11 (`-0.354, -0.406, -0.350, -0.482`), peaking at the apex in cols 5..6 (`b3[17] = -0.143`, `b3[18] = -0.105`).
   - **Row 2 (pixels 24..35):** widens to cols 4..8 (`-0.170, -0.013, -0.054, -0.055, -0.173`).
   - **Row 3 (pixels 36..47):** widens to cols 3..9 (`-0.132, -0.114, -0.077, -0.065, -0.161, -0.099, -0.197`).
   - **Row 4 (pixels 48..59):** cols 2..7 are near zero (`-0.077, -0.052, -0.067, -0.024, -0.039, 0.018`).
   - **Rows 5..9 (pixels 60..119):** high values span cols 2..9 in Row 5 (`-0.080, 0.049, -0.026, -0.045, 0.048, 0.063, -0.044, -0.069`), widening to cols 1..10 by Row 6 (`-0.152` to `0.046`) and Row 9 (`-0.006, -0.047, -0.155, -0.079, -0.071, -0.033, 0.018, 0.005, -0.054, -0.123`).
   - **Row 10 (pixels 120..131):** moderate negative values across cols 1..10 (`-0.234` to `-0.001`), and **Row 11 (pixels 132..143)** drops off to `-0.456..-0.104`.

2. **Active pixel rows in `W1` (rows 0..143) match a triangular envelope:**
   - **Row 0 (rows 0..11 of `W1`), Col 0 (rows $12r$), and Col 11 (rows $12r+11$):** every single weight across all 64 columns is near-zero noise ($\le 0.034$ in magnitude).
   - **Row 1 (rows 12..23 of `W1`):** rows 12..14 (cols 0..2) and 21..23 (cols 9..11) have only tiny weights ($\le 0.020$). Large weights appear only in **cols 3..8** (e.g., `W1[15, 4] = 0.112`, `W1[16, 5] = 0.105`, `W1[17, 19] = 0.389`, `W1[18, 58] = 0.173`, `W1[19, 28] = 0.157`, `W1[20, 14] = 0.176`).
   - **Rows 2..3 (rows 24..47 of `W1`):** rows 24..25 (cols 0..1) and 34..35 (cols 10..11) are tiny ($\le 0.024$); large weights appear only in **cols 2..9** (e.g., `W1[26, 4] = 0.088`, `W1[27, 4] = 0.314`, `W1[29, 19] = 0.629`, `W1[32, 14] = 0.396`, `W1[33, 14] = 0.138`).
   - **Rows 4..11 (rows 48..143 of `W1`):** large weights span **cols 1..10** (e.g., `W1[49, 4] = 0.121` at r4c1, `W1[58, 14] = 0.157` at r4c10, `W1[121, 25] = 0.371` at r10c1, `W1[130, 8] = 0.213` at r10c10).

Row 31 traces `(r1,c7)=0.174 -> (r2,c7..8)=0.252, 0.235 -> (r3,c8)=0.556 -> (r4,c8..9)=0.461, 0.396 -> (r5,c9)=0.619 -> (r6,c9..10)=0.341, 0.393`.
   - **Horizontal bottom bars (`_`) in rows 6..11 only:**
     - In `W1`: Unit 24 has `-0.114..-0.367` across r6, cols 1..8; Unit 47 has `-0.079..-0.426` across r7, cols 1..10; Units 12 and 13 have `-0.054..-0.361` across r8, cols 1..10; Unit 44 has `+0.084..+0.361` and Unit 31 has `-0.084..-0.329` across r9, cols 1..10; Unit 8 has `+0.069..+0.483` and Unit 17 has `-0.107..-0.360` across r10, cols 1..10; Unit 38 has `+0.129..+0.326` across r11, cols 1..10.
     - In `W3`: Row 12 is positive along r6 cols 2..8 (`0.101..0.295`) and negative across r7..9 (`-0.211..-0.328` at r8); Row 35 is positive along r7 cols 1..10 (`0.089..0.465`); Row 11 is positive along r8 cols 2..9 (`0.084..0.273`) and strongly negative along r9 cols 2..9 (`-0.178..-0.417`); Row 33 is positive along r9 cols 1..8 (`0.069..0.455`); Row 20 is positive along r10 cols 1..10 (`0.169..0.403`); Row 40 (`0.306..0.485` at r10 cols 2..7) and Row 60 (`0.126..0.425` at r10 cols 5..10) also draw the horizontal base at r10..11.
   - **Filled triangle interiors:**
     - In `W3`, Row 41 is positive throughout the entire upper triangle interior: r1 cols 5..6 (`0.076, 0.046`), r2 cols 5..6 (`0.132, 0.109`), r3 cols 4..7 (`0.063..0.178`), r4 cols 3..7 (`0.063..0.165`), r5 cols 2..7 (`0.047..0.147`), r6 cols 3..8 (`0.046..0.115`), r7 cols 7..9 (`0.104..0.221`), and negative at r8..9 (`-0.129..-0.186`).
     - Row 32 is positive across the interior at r6 cols 5..8 (`0.092..0.201`), r7 cols 3..8 (`0.111..0.261`), r8 cols 2..9 (`0.107..0.343`), and r9 cols 3..9 (`0.080..0.231`).
     - Row 49 fills the central core at r7 col 6 (`0.404`), r8 cols 5..7 (`0.254, 0.413, 0.200`), and r9 cols 5..7 (`0.301, 0.264, 0.379`).
     - Row 63 (which has a large positive bias `b2[63] = 0.437`) is negative on the outer border (`-0.072..-0.102`) and positive across the central triangle interior: r5 cols 4..7 (`0.076, 0.141, 0.056, 0.016`), r6 cols 4..7 (`0.119, 0.214, 0.148, 0.061`), r7 cols 4..8 (`0.067, 0.119, 0.109, 0.072, 0.013`), and r8 cols 3..8 (`0.025, 0.100, 0.154, 0.156, 0.118, 0.075`).

---

**Reasoning:**
- **Why upright triangles:** Every spatial feature in `W1` and `W3` belongs to one of three boundary orientations—a left edge sloping down-left (`/`), a right edge sloping down-right (`\`), or a horizontal bottom edge (`_`)—plus solid interior fills bounded by them. Moreover, `W1` hasUnit 19 explicitly acting as a V-shaped apex detector at `(r1..2, c5)` splitting into left and right arms (`(r5,c3)=0.220` and `(r5,c7)=0.183`, with `(r5,c5)=0.006`).
- **Why other shapes and orientations are ruled out:**
  - *Rectangles, squares, or vertical bars* are ruled out because there are no vertical edge detectors in columns 1..10; the upper corners `(r1..3, c1..2)` and `(r1..3, c9..10)` have zero/noise weights in `W1`, and all lateral edges slope inward toward the top center at roughly $\pm 0.5$ columns per row.
  - *Inverted, left-pointing, or right-pointing triangles* are ruled out because horizontal bar detectors/drawers exist exclusively in the bottom half of the grid (rows 6..11), never in rows 1..5, and the active width of `W1` monotonically narrows toward the top (cols 1..10 in rows 4..11, cols 2..9 in rows 2..3, cols 3..8 in row 1).
  - *Circles or ovals* are ruled out because the bottom boundary features are strictly flat, full-width horizontal segments (e.g., `W1` Unit 44 has `0.235, 0.305, 0.320, 0.349, 0.361, 0.353, 0.333, 0.248` across r9 cols 2..9; `W1` Unit 38 has `0.210..0.326` across r11 cols 2..9) and the side boundaries are straight lines from row 1 to row 10.
  - *Hollow/outlined triangles* are ruled out because `b3` and interior units (`W3` rows 32, 41, 43, 49, 63) assign their most positive weights to the deep interior pixels `(r4..8, c4..7)`. The edge-specific units exist because the triangles vary in size and exact edge placement across the training set, so the network adjusts where the left diagonal, right diagonal, and bottom horizontal base cut off around the always-white central core.

---

**Images:**
The model generates **filled white upright (isosceles) triangles on a black background**:
- **Color/Polarity:** The triangle (interior and boundary) is white (`+1`, `#`) and the background is black (`-1`, `.`).
- **Orientation:** Upright—a single apex at the top center and a flat horizontal base at the bottom.
- **Position and Size:**
  - Never touches the 1-pixel outer border of the 12 × 12 image (row 0, col 0, and col 11 are always black).
  - **Apex:** Located near the top middle, at rows 1..3 and columns 4..7 (most typically row 1 or 2, cols 5..6).
  - **Sloped sides:** Symmetrical left (`/`) and right (`\`) edges that widen by roughly 0.5–0.6 columns on each side per row downward (about 1 pixel wider per row overall).
  - **Horizontal base:** Located in the lower half of the image at rows 6..10 (occasionally row 11), spanning between 6 and 10 pixels wide (within columns 1..10), giving a triangle height of 6 to 10 pixels.
